mode: interactive session, imported by the Python evaluator
blinding: Shuffled opaque IDs; judge received only target language and poem text, not generator, k, corpus size, or Python metrics.
procedure: One text-grounded assessment per poem by the same commercial model across three language batches; not independent human raters.
anchors: 1 very poor; 2 weak; 3 adequate; 4 good; 5 excellent
assamese_limitation: All 30 Assamese poems were reviewed but abstained on literary scores because the model could not reliably assess native idiom and meaning.
not_run: No Gemini API calls were made. These are actual ChatGPT session judgments, not simulated Gemini scores.
